sloka: ततस्तौ राम निघ्नन्तौ तदान्योन्यं महामृधे ।न विह्वलौ न च श्रान्तौ बभूवतुरमर्षणौ ।। ७.१५.३० ॥
transliteration: tatastau rāma nighnantau tadānyonyaṁ mahāmṛdhe ।na vihvalau na ca śrāntau babhūvaturamarṣaṇau ।। 7.15.30 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, then those two, striking each other in that great battle, became neither distressed nor weary, but remained furious.
